title: Cleveland Browns defense starting to show some cracks in the armor

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cleveland Browns defense starting to show some cracks in the armor
sources.description: The Cleveland Browns defense has been feeling the pressure through the first nine weeks of the season. Following the complete team meltdown in Week 1 against Jacksonville, the defense has carried more than its share of the water each week. It has become a familiar script: the defense keeps the Browns in the game while […]
